newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FENCING-FRANCE COME OUT ON TOP.
newsitem.headline: FENCING-FRANCE COME OUT ON TOP.

text.p: France collected the team sabre gold to finish top of the world fencing championships medals table on Saturday.
It took their tally of titles to three -- after victories in the men's individual epee and men's team foil -- to add to their four bronze medals.
Cuba finished second with two golds and two silvers, with Italy third with two golds, one silver and three bronze.
Facing a Russian sabre team including world and Olympic champion Sergei Pozdniakov, France finally edged to a nervy 45-42 victory.
Pozdniakov closed an eight-point gap to two in the final bout before world number two Damien Touya completed victory for the French.
Earlier Hungary won their first gold medal of the championships when they defeated Germany 45-40 in the final of the women's team epee.

Their trio of individual epee bronze medallist Gyongyi Szalay, Adrien Hormay and Timea Nagy condemned Claudia Bokel, Katja Nass and Imke Duplitzer to Germany's third runners-up position of the championships.
